title: Adjustable Hand Mold & Liquid Alloy Casting Kinetics
discipline: Two-Part Hand Mold Kinematics · Liquid Alloy Hydrodynamics · Antimony Solidification Expansion · Gutenberg Mass-Production Mechanics
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the mechanical kinematics of Gutenberg's two-part sliding L-shaped hand mold (governed by the hydrodynamic inertial pressure ΔP = ρ·a·h of the founder's upward jerk, Young-Laplace capillary surface tension ΔP = 2γ/r in micro-serif channels, and anomalous solidification expansion of ternary lead-antimony-tin alloy), proving that variable horizontal set-width clamping combined with hydrodynamic flash-free casting established the true mechanical foundation of interchangeable mass-production typography?
